decision: Selected the centroid of the union of Denton County parcels 1016063 (Texas Instruments Addn Block A Lot 1RA1, 143.498 legal acres, owner Digital Lewisville LLC, situs 2501 S SH 121) and 1016064 (Lot 1RA2, 24.756 legal acres, owner DDI Lewisville LLC, situs 2501 Edmonds Ln) as the campus locator for Digital Realty's Lewisville (Digital Convergence) campus. It locates the 168-acre campus, not the DFW44 building on lot 1RA2, its data hall 4 shell addition or any works.

computed.method: shapely 2.1.1 union and polygon centroid in served lon/lat; pyproj 3.7.1 WGS84 geodesic area and extents; Esri rings with counter-clockwise orientation treated as holes

identity_bridge: TDLR TABS2027001867 'Project Gold Phase 2 DFW44' (registered 2026-09-24): shell addition of the future data hall 4 (43,607 sq ft) to the existing DFW44 data center building at 2501 Edmonds Lane, Lewisville, Denton County; owner Digital Realty.

TDLR TABS2022026326 'Digital Realty - Project Gold Lewisville' (registered 2022-08-16): new single-story shell data center building with shell space for three data halls at 2501 Edmonds Ln, owner Digital Lewisville, LLC; TABS2026019308 (2026-05-04) registers a suite fit-out within the existing DFW44 building at the same address.

Parcel 1016064's situs is 2501 Edmonds Ln and the Denco 9-1-1 point for 2501 Edmonds Ln falls inside it; its owner DDI Lewisville LLC shares the mailing address 2501 S State Highway 121 Bus Ste 400D with Digital Lewisville LLC, the owner of the adjoining lot 1RA1 (situs 2501 S SH 121) and the owner named in TABS2022026326.

Digital Realty's DFW26 page places DFW26 at 2501 State Highway 121, Lewisville, on its 168-acre Digital Convergence campus of ten buildings with 60 more acres to grow; the two lots total 168.254 legal acres (168.5 geodesic) and the 9-1-1 points for 2501 S SH 121 Bus (buildings 1-12) fall in lot 1RA1.
alternatives_rejected: Lot 1RA2 centroid alone: would locate only the DFW44 parcel and leave the rest of the same Digital Convergence campus as a separate point.
Texas Instruments Addn Block A Lot 2 (5.477 acres, Texas Instruments Inc): not a Digital Realty parcel; it is a hole in lot 1RA1 and is excluded from the union.
Digital Realty's own map coordinate for DFW26 (33.0533231, -96.9173431, in the Dallas metro page data) lies 9.8 km from the campus parcels and is not used.
Census or commercial geocoders: not used.

consistency_checks.owner_match: parcel situs equals the registered address; both lot owners share one mailing address on the campus
consistency_checks.area_match: 168.254 legal acres versus the operator's 168-acre campus
